parts.label: a
parts.description: Vertical and horizontal asymptotes of f(x) = 2/(x-3) + 1
parts.tolerance: A1 for x = 3, A1 for y = 1.
parts.notes: A1 for the vertical asymptote x = 3. A1 for the horizontal asymptote y = 1 (A1A1).

parts.label: b
parts.description: Describe fully the transformations mapping y = 1/x onto f(x) = 2/(x-3) + 1
parts.tolerance: "Describe fully" requires WORDS, not symbols alone. One mark per correctly described transformation (A1A1A1). STRETCH: a word from stretch/dilate/dilation/scale (or an equivalent such as 'doubled vertically'), scale factor 2 (accept 'factor of two'), with direction stated as vertical (accept 'parallel to the y-axis'). HORIZONTAL TRANSLATION: translate/translation/shift/slide, magnitude 3, with 'right' explicit (accept 'positive x-direction'). VERTICAL TRANSLATION: translate/shift/slide, magnitude 1, up (direction may be omitted for an upward translation — assumed upward). The word 'units' is optional. Reject 'move'/'moved'.
parts.notes: A1 vertical stretch scale factor 2 (direction vertical stated). A1 horizontal translation 3 right (explicit). A1 vertical translation 1 up.
parts.order_rule: The stretch must precede the vertical translation; the horizontal translation may appear in any position (stretch and horizontal translation interchangeable). If the vertical translation is stated before the stretch, deduct 1 mark.
parts.vector_form: Accept the two translations as a vector, e.g. (3, 1), for BOTH translation marks, PROVIDED a translation word (translate/shift/slide) is used; the vector supplies direction and magnitude.
parts.symbolic_fallback: A description using NO transformation words (e.g. an equation chain 1/x -> 2/x -> 2/(x-3) -> 2/(x-3)+1) that is correct and complete earns at most 1 of 3. A vector accompanied by a translation word is NOT this case (award the translation marks in full).

parts.label: d
parts.notes: M1 for setting f(x) = 0 and reaching x - 3 = -2. A1 for x = 1.

parts.label: a
parts.description: Vertical and horizontal asymptotes of g(x) = (2x+1)/(x-1)
parts.tolerance: A1 for x = 1, A1 for y = 2.
parts.notes: A1 for x = 1. A1 for y = 2 (ratio of leading coefficients) (A1A1).

parts.label: b
parts.tolerance: Accept x = -1/2 and y = -1, or the ordered-pair forms (A1A1).
parts.notes: A1 for x-intercept (-1/2, 0). A1 for y-intercept (0, -1).

parts.label: c
parts.notes: M1 for swapping x and y. A1 for correct rearrangement to y(x-2) = x+1. A1 for g^{-1}(x) = (x+1)/(x-2).

parts.label: d
parts.follow_through: Award A1 for x != (the candidate's horizontal-asymptote value of g from part (a)).
